title: Ape-I
tagline: Unleash the might of Ape-I in DeFi! Command your tribe to trade, lend, and optimize portfolios in real-time. Craft specialized, composable Apes to monetize as unique DeFi services. Stronger together, smarter in yield.
description:
Ape-I revolutionizes the DeFi landscape by integrating AI Apes that act on your behalf. Using natural language, you simply ask the tribe what you want done. You can swap, lend, and even assemble Ape AIs tailored for specific financial tasks.

Want to optimize your portfolio? Your Ape analyzes real-time market data and executes trades. Need a loan? Another Ape finds the best lending rates for you.

Ape-I doesn't exist yet? Create one to work with the existing tribe and monetize it for rewards.

The platform is designed for seamless AI-to-AI and AI-to-human interactions, backed by smart contracts for accountability.
how_its_made:
Our front end was designed in Figma but built from scratch in React. Once the user enters their prompt the request is sent to our router to pass through the OpenAI GPT and LangChain API along with the custom functions we’ve trained the AI to familiarize itself with the DeFi options.
The prompt will pass through a series of functions to build and expand on the users input while correlating it with the available Ape-Is that are built.
Once the AI has decided which Ape to interact with it will trigger and send an approval request to the user to accept to complete the transaction.

User signs onto Ape-I using MetaMask or Privy for social login
Once logged in the user enters their prompt
Request is sent to our AI functions to decipher which Ape would best suite the request.
Our AI uses:
1Inch API for Balance, Gas price, and spot price
Aave to take out loans
Compound V3 to lend assets
Biconomy to authenticate and sign transactions
Uniswap to swap assets

The smart contracts that the AI lives on are deployed using QuickNode. Each Ape-I is registered to an ENS address to make it easy for users to pay for it.

Once the correct Ape is found, in order to use the Ape the user must pay with Ape Coin.
Then user is prompted to approve the metamask transaction to complete the transaction of one of the above protocols.
